prd.title: Coming Soon Page
prd.overview: The Coming Soon Page is the generic placeholder for the 3 still-pending Phase 2 routes: /approve, /audit, /vendor. /submit is removed from this mapping (now routes to SubmitReportPage per WO-011). Phase 2 notice ("Coming in Phase 2"). Tier 3 (light, placeholder).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/ComingSoonPage.tsx (86 LOC); remove /submit mapping in App.tsx

requirement.title: Mount 3 placeholder routes (/approve, /audit, /vendor)
requirement.description: Register ComingSoonPage at /approve, /audit, /vendor. Each renders generic placeholder with Phase 2 notice.

requirement.title: Remove /submit mapping from ComingSoonPage
requirement.description: /submit is now a real route per WO-011. Remove ComingSoonPage mapping from /submit in App.tsx. SubmitReportPage now owns /submit.

acceptance.criterion: grep '/submit' in ComingSoonPage route registrations returns zero hits
Navigating to /submit renders SubmitReportPage, not ComingSoonPage

requirement.title: Phase 2 notice ("Coming in Phase 2")
requirement.description: Render "Coming in Phase 2" notice on each placeholder route. Role-specific messaging for /approve (PHA), /audit (placeholder audit), /vendor (vendor flow).

acceptance.criterion: Role-specific message renders for each route

requirement.title: Bangla toggle works on placeholder pages
requirement.description: Locale toggle (EN/BN) on each placeholder page. Preference persists in IDB.

acceptance.criterion: Toggle changes locale on each placeholder route

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: coming-soon-page, …-header, …-main, …-phase-notice, …-role-specific-message.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN; Phase 2 notice)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for "Coming in Phase 2" + role-specific messaging. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm /submit removal + 3 placeholder routes
requirement.description: Verify /submit removed from ComingSoonPage mapping; verify 3 routes render placeholder; verify no Hindi strings.

acceptance.criterion: grep '/submit' in ComingSoonPage routes returns zero hits

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Navigate to /approve, /audit, /vendor; assert ComingSoonPage renders. Navigate to /submit; assert SubmitReportPage renders. 3 placeholders + 1 real route correct.
Mount /approve; assert "Coming in Phase 2" notice + PHA-specific message. Notice + role-specific message render.
